source_language_scope: Supplied English records only; no new original-language or apparatus verification.
numbering: Exact original order, native fields, references and anchors retained: 1374 units, 51 numbered chapters and a translator’s prologue, 52 native source groups.
method: Complete actual source and target passages with necessary context were read and each retained explanation separately reread in recorded batches. Source-only deferrals and unresolved candidates receive zero completion credit. Technical inventory is separate from semantic review.
completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.
canon_policy: Old Testament cross-references exclusively within the Saints Holy Bible 70-book edition: 43 source books in their exact order and divisions; matching targets restricted to its 70 books.
